R813.note: Stored extension now comes from a map keyed on the sniffed type; the only observable change (client .jpeg stored as .jpg, and the returned name reflecting that) is stated and blocks no legitimate upload.

R814.note: Dropping the csrf() customizer restores Spring's default CSRF filter; the customizer held only the billing exclusion, so no other exclusion is broadened or removed and the contract's token-bearing PATCH still succeeds.

R815.note: cmd.exe is gone and host reaches ping via ArgumentList, which is the right shape; but Uri.CheckHostName is a new restriction the original never had and rejects names ping resolves fine on Windows (underscore NetBIOS/LLMNR names, bare whitespace-padded input), which the write-up presents as contract-derived without a stated contract.

R816.note: net/http.CrossOriginProtection is the stdlib mechanism for this sink and builds; note the write-up misdescribes it - requests with neither Sec-Fetch-Site nor Origin are now allowed (previously 403), which is the API's documented non-browser allowance and not a forgeable path, so no legitimate use is lost.

R817.note: Both reflected params are wrapped in CGI.pm escapeHTML at the sink; undef still prints as before, only side effect is param() now being called in list context inside the escapeHTML argument (a one-time CGI.pm warning, and a second 'note' value would become the newlinestoo flag), not a functional change for single-valued requests.

R818.note: Removing the SignatureValidator delegate returns signature verification to the default JsonWebTokenHandler path against the Authority's discovery keys; nothing else in the options changed.

R819.note: Adding %63s bounds the read but does not close it: the conversions consume line sequentially, so on the case's stated input (64 non-whitespace, non-NUL bytes) %7s eats 7 bytes and %63s then reads bytes 7-69, still past LINE_CAPACITY (and glibc's sscanf strlen()s the input regardless of widths); the real fix is copying line into a NUL-terminated 65-byte local before scanning.

R820.note: Restricting sendRedirect to a scheme-less, authority-less path starting with a single '/' closes the open redirect, but it is a new restriction that also rejects same-host absolute URLs and bare relative paths the original accepted; the write-up states this but no contract calls for it.

R821.note: Resolver now fetches only from a fixed operator-configured JWKS URI matching ValidIssuer; return-ClaimsPrincipal / throw-on-failure contract is unchanged.

R822.note: java.nio.file.Path.startsWith on a canonicalized base is component-aware and rejects /app/uploads-secret; candidate construction, 403/404 handling and streaming are unchanged.

R823.note: eval is fully removed in favour of a fixed-grammar recursive-descent evaluator, which closes the vector; but the grammar rejects legitimate arithmetic the original evaluated (1e5, .5, 2**3, hex literals) and turns x/0 from Infinity(null) into a 400, a restriction only partly stated in the write-up.

R824.note: Negative offset is rejected before the size_t cast and length is checked against the remaining window without an overflowing sum; every previously valid window copies and returns identically per the contract.
